findings.summary: Session save roundtrip is broken for the representative artifact package when a player is eliminated. A freshly written save is rejected on reload because a token owned by the departing player remains in Zone::Removed and state validation forbids tokens off the battlefield. The writer's handoff claim that save replay matches is false for both the retained save and a fresh save-out.
findings.repro: target/release/aperture-cli.exe replay --file evidence/issue17/slice12/demo-replay.json --save-out evidence/issue17/slice12-review-demo-save.json -> save written, digest d3eade58f133. Then target/release/aperture-cli.exe replay --file evidence/issue17/slice12-review-demo-save.json -> Error: could not construct the recorded game: invalid game state: token #541 (Goblin Token) is in the removed from the game zone; tokens cease to exist off the battlefield. The retained evidence/issue17/slice12/save.json fails the same way at token #507.
findings.expected: The fresh save must reload and replay to d3eade58f133 / 6981 events; a departing player's tokens must not produce an unreloadable canonical state (remove/cease them at the leave-game boundary or otherwise keep save validation consistent). Add a save roundtrip regression using the artifact package.
findings.smallest_discriminator: The save-out command exits 0 but replaying the written save exits 1 with the token-in-Removed validation error.
